questions.question: What role does attentional load play in the accuracy of visual search tasks?

answers.a: Higher attentional load improves accuracy by focusing perception.
answers.b: Lower attentional load increases the risk of false alarms.
answers.c: High attentional load can reduce accuracy due to divided attention.
answers.d: Attentional load does not influence search performance.

explanations.a: Incorrect. High load often impairs accuracy due to limited cognitive resources.
explanations.b: Incorrect. Lower load typically improves performance.
explanations.c: Correct! Dividing attention makes it harder to detect targets accurately.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Attentional load is a key factor in performance outcomes.

questions.question: How does visual crowding affect target detection in peripheral vision?

answers.a: It improves detection by enhancing contrast.
answers.b: It impairs detection by making target features harder to isolate.
answers.c: It has no effect on target perception outside central vision.
answers.d: It increases search speed due to reduced detail.

explanations.a: Incorrect. Crowding tends to reduce contrast and clarity.
explanations.b: Correct! In peripheral vision, nearby items can obscure the target's features.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Crowding significantly affects peripheral detection.
explanations.d: Incorrect. It slows search by decreasing visibility and precision.

questions.question: Which factor is most likely to facilitate a faster visual search in dynamic (moving) environments?

answers.b: Stable and predictable motion of the target

explanations.b: Correct! Predictable motion allows attention to track the target more efficiently.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Random distractor movement makes search harder.
explanations.d: Incorrect. More moving distractors increase cognitive demand.
